title: Enrich language culture and product unit references safely
reason: User catalogue carries language,culture,description,size unit and weight unit. Sakila language names could map to reviewed language codes; AdventureWorks padded culture codes,legacy zh-cht and invariant whitespace need explicit locale policy. Local KG/LB/BOX unit names require dimensional versus packaging review. Ask which translations are missing and which quantities are comparable. Visuals: language coverage grid and dimension tree. No customer language inferred from country; original film language nulls excluded. UCUM transformation rights unresolved; CLDR has a separate unit namespace. Manual crosswalk and measured matches remain missing.
practical_value: Proposed connected bundle; identity, temporal, legal and match-rate review required. Not selected or implemented.
showcase_value: Named visualisations support the questions; practical joinability dominates.
